Eli (marketing): quick sync — targeting Optimize v2 announce Tue 09:00 PT. need final changelog URL + docs quickstart + confirmed rollout window. can eng lock a window?
Nina (eng): propose canary 05:30 PT, 10% 06:15, 50% 07:30, manual go at 09:00. rollback if 5xx >5% sustained 3m.
Eli (marketing): marketing will hold mass mailers until 09:10 to avoid spike. small organic posts ok after 09:00.
Kai (docs): docs PR ready: https://docs.redwood.ai/pr/523 — changelog draft + quickstart. will merge after migration note.
Sam (devex): webinar live demo at 10:00 PT. landing page draft: https://redwood.ai/webinar/optimize-v2-preview — need 3 bullets for hero and a 1-line intro.
Nina (eng): bullets: "~2x faster on long-context chats", "up to 20% lower per-token cost", "95th <120ms on 32k tests". intro: "See how Optimize v2 speeds up long conversations and cuts costs."
Eli (marketing): nice. please give a short caveat sentence we can use in social.
Nina (eng): caveat: "actual gains vary by workload and traffic; see docs for benchmarks."
DeployBot: deploy window reserved: staging canary @ 2026-05-05T05:30:00Z, prod start @ 2026-05-05T09:00:00Z. Auto-rollback: sustained 5xx >5% for 3m.
Oncall: i'll monitor dashboards and post gate status. ping @oncall if escalation.
Kai (docs): merged — changelog URL: https://docs.redwood.ai/changelog/optimize-v2 ; quickstart: https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstart/optimize-v2. added migration note.
Eli (marketing): perfect. final day-of checklist: eng monitor canary + paste merge link (you); docs verify redirects (you); devex webinar CTA (you); marketing publish blog at 09:00, hold mass sends until 09:10 (me). any blockers?
Nina (eng): none. will post status updates during rollout.
